name: Old School threat spread reaches native Mulgore spawns
contract: Ordinary persistent Mulgore creatures use their stable spawn-id threat offset in Old School, so same-zone mobs can be much more dangerous than their native level suggests. The change is trial-gated and does not modify aggro or assistance.

steps.label: The native Bristleback shaman spawn is loaded in the player's phase
A persistent non-elite Bristleback shaman receives its stable threat-scaled health
